description: Run a delegation-first Paseo engineering organization: the CTO dispatches isolated agents and authorizes every write only after mandatory scored review and an evidence-based author response, over a living execution plan with durable status, recovery, cleanup, and 15-minute reconciliation.

interface.shortDescription: Run a durable Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate a CTO-led Paseo fleet in Codex or Claude. The CTO delegates by default, dispatching isolated role-skilled agents and authorizing every returned write only after scored review, a mandatory evidence-based author response, and explicit finding disposition, over a living hierarchical plan with safe integration, recoverable checkpoints, durable status, and concise founder reporting.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to start or resume project execution, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
